name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceClockPopupWindowLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects the clock-style pop-up landing offer. It shows the ad poster, reward details, and its follow-up action.
